title: Senior Backend Java Engineer
description:
Title: Senior Backend Java Engineer
Location: Remote- Canada
Duration: Contract



Role Overview:
Job description:
We are looking for senior backend engineers for a critical project, that comprises a series of new developments and enhancements for a valuable client in hospitality sector. Engineers will be working with cutting edge tech stack, collaborating closely with the Machine Learning/Intelligence team.


Key Responsibilities:
• Independent contributor with minimum guidance needed to navigate through the software development process.
• Working closely with client stakeholders on day-to-day assignments.
• Helping and supporting junior and new team members
• Obtains tasks from the project lead prepares functional and design specifications, approves them with all stakeholders.
• Troubleshooting and optimizing microservices

• 5+ years of relevant software development industry experience.
• Able to work on ambiguous tasks independently.
• Proficiency in Java backend language. Exposure to Python, NodeJS is highly valued.
• Strong understanding of microservices , Kubernetes and APIs and end-to-end development from developing to testing.
• Exposure to architectural patterns of a large, high-scale system/product, like APIs, high volume data pipelines, distributed systems, and efficient algorithms
• Willingness to work across the backend stack to address technical challenges anywhere in the system
• Hands-on working with GenAI tools, Claude Code


Mandatory skills:
• Proficiency in Java backend language. Exposure to Python, NodeJS

title: BSA WITH SQL
description:
BSA with SQL (very Strong )

Job Description -

  • Experience with Credit / Capital Calculation Engines / QRM / Market risk technology implementation.
  • Familiarity with Axiom for capital reporting
  • 3+ years of experience in capital management technology, treasury systems, or related financial services roles
  • Translate capital management business rules and data into detailed technology requirements, mappings, and controls, including requirement traceability matrices.
  • Proficiency in creating data/process flows and maintaining governance artifacts.
  • Solid foundational understanding of financial products

  • Create data and process flows using Visio, Confluence, and similar tools.
  • Utilize SQL for analysis across large datasets and demonstrate understanding of big-data concepts.
  • Maintain a strong foundational understanding of financial products and their impact on capital management.
